about.title: About
about.paragraph1: I work at the intersection of medical imaging, applied machine learning, and language models. At the Sino-Park Centre of Artificial Intelligence (SPCAI) and PAF-IAST in Pakistan, I develop two-stage deep learning pipelines for intracranial hemorrhage localization on RSNA DICOM scans and teach undergraduate computer science and AI laboratories in Python.
about.paragraph2: My bachelor's thesis on predicting healthcare insurance claim denials became a peer-reviewed article in Frontiers in Health Services (Scopus Q1), evaluated on 678,881 U.S. claim lines. Alongside supervising 150+ student engineering projects, I am a prospective PhD candidate in Computer Science, Medical AI, and low-resource / multilingual NLP for the September 2027 intake onwards.

intro.label: Hello
intro.title: Hi. I'm *Obaidullah.*
intro.text: I build machine learning for medicine, and I teach people to build. This is the short version of how I got here. Scroll, and I'll walk you through it.

roots.label: Roots
roots.title: It started with *an exam.*
roots.text: I finished high school at Taayef Private High School, then sat the Kankor, Afghanistan's national university entrance exam. My result placed me in Computer Science.

border.label: Scholarship
border.title: Then a scholarship took me *across a border.*
border.text: The HEC Allama Iqbal Scholarship, won through a competitive exam, brought me to PAF-IAST for a B.S. in Computer Science. I spent the breaks writing real software: a customised Moodle, an LMS on SQL Server, a hospital management system in ASP.NET.
border.extra: In 2023 I won the university's Robo Tech 01 robotics competition.

paper.label: First paper
paper.title: My first real dataset: *678,881 insurance claims.*
paper.text: At Cube Healthcare (remote, Michigan) I modelled why U.S. insurance claims get denied. It became my BS thesis, and in October 2026 a peer-reviewed paper in Frontiers in Health Services (Scopus Q1).
paper.statCaption: PR-AUC, against a no-skill baseline of 0.330

question.label: The question
question.title: Can a model spot a brain bleed, and *say when it isn't sure?*
question.text: My M.S. thesis (CGPA 4.00/4.00) and my research at SPCAI: a gatekeeper model flags intracranial hemorrhage on RSNA CT scans, a specialist names the subtype, and MC Dropout uncertainty lets it abstain instead of guessing.
question.statCaption: Minutes of radiology turnaround, down from 38 (RSNA 2026 abstract, submitted)

teaching.label: Teaching
teaching.title: Along the way, *I started teaching.*
teaching.text: I teach OOP, data structures and AI labs, where students implement algorithms from first principles. Every team I supervise ships a live app.
teaching.extra: In 2026 I also ran a 144-hour Power BI workshop for 50+ graduates at KPITB.
